title: 跨節點累計、Shadow/Enforce 模式切換、月初重置與臨時覆寫 (Cross-Node Fair-Use, Shadow/Enforce, Monthly Reset & Temporary Override)
expected: Fair-Use policy enforces tier invariants, aggregates member usage across multiple serving exits (node & node2), transitions from shadow to enforce mode and across usage thresholds by recompiling only carrying exits, installing Tier 2 kernel tc classes on both exits, and clearing fair_use.applying from true to false once both carrying exits acknowledge the compiled generation, while ignoring duplicate/replayed events and preserving per-incarnation retained usage across node re-enrollment.
actual: Live multi-node test enrolled second exit 01a191d7-8b10-79d7-b50b-6c299efa7054 (node2) and non-carrying node 01a191d8-d1fe-7011-87f0-207981159436, routed memberA traffic across both carrying exits (aggregating 28517 bytes across 2 exits), verified shadow mode (60Mbit on node, 15Mbit on node2), proved Transition 1 (policy.activated mode=enforce: carrying gens node 10->13, node2 4->5, non-carrying 0->0; Tier 2 5Mbit/2Mbit tc classes on both exits; fair_use.applying true->false in 6293 ms via observation 01a191d9-014c-7c45-b31d-ea19231ff5ae; replay no double bump) and Transition 2 (fup.member_generation_changed via usage threshold crossing: carrying gens node 14->15, node2 6->7, non-carrying 0->0; Tier 2 5Mbit/2Mbit tc classes on both exits; fair_use.applying true->false in 49139 ms via observation 01a191d9-ed99-73bc-9a98-0cb8c47e288f; replay no double bump), and verified ENR-03 per-incarnation retained usage across node2 re-enrollment (01a191d7-8c4a-781b-b030-0669a98e48eb -> 01a191da-2795-7e0c-a7e6-875992f6931a).
